assets.automation.title: Asset Automation
assets.automation.description: Create focused WHEN / IF / THEN rules for asset lifecycle, warranty, software baseline and license signals.
assets.automation.list.title: Asset automation rules
assets.automation.list.description: Module-owned rules reuse the shared immutable automation runtime without exposing a global workflow app.
assets.automation.search.label: Search automation

assets.automation.table.name: Automation
assets.automation.boundary.title: Module-owned execution
assets.automation.boundary.description: Only actions backed by current Assets and Helpdesk contracts are available. Automatic event dispatch is not enabled yet.
assets.automation.editor.description: Define one deterministic Assets rule without opening the full workflow canvas.
assets.automation.editor.name: Rule name
assets.automation.editor.namePlaceholder: e.g. Open a ticket when a license is overused
assets.automation.editor.whenDescription: Choose the current Asset or Software License signal required before a run can start.
assets.automation.editor.ifDescription: Optionally narrow the selected resource context.
assets.automation.editor.thenDescription: Apply an approved Assets action or create a Helpdesk ticket.
assets.automation.editor.ticketDescripti: Describe the issue and include supported resource tokens if useful.
assets.automation.editor.validation.name: Enter a rule name.
assets.automation.editor.validation.cond: Complete the IF condition or turn it off.
assets.automation.catalog.lifecycle.desc: Requires the selected Asset to be in the configured lifecycle state.
assets.automation.catalog.ownerUnassigne: Requires the selected Asset to have no owner.
assets.automation.catalog.warrantyExpiri: Requires the Asset warranty to be inside the configured threshold.
Requires the latest persisted software baseline result to be missing.
assets.automation.catalog.licenseOveruse: Requires used seats to exceed entitled seats.
assets.automation.catalog.setLifecycle.d: Updates the selected Asset lifecycle state using the normal Assets permission boundary.
assets.automation.catalog.createTicket.d: Creates a Helpdesk ticket using the automation actor's current Helpdesk permission.
assets.automation.catalog.end.label: End
